subject.title: improve: let Code Mode use declared tool result shapes

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `outputSchema` as the supported public plugin API for describing and validating `AgentToolResult.details` across Code Mode and Tool Search?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and well-proven, but adding a permanent plugin API and fail-closed validation semantics requires explicit owner acceptance under the repository's SDK compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve the bounded contract
options.body: Adopt the optional API as proposed, retaining unknown/raw-first behavior when omitted and requiring exact-head proof after conflict resolution.

options.title: Keep it internal-only
options.body: Remove the public SDK exposure and limit result hints to built-in tools until the external contract is designed separately.

options.title: Defer result contracts
options.body: Pause or close this direction and keep all Code Mode outputs unknown until maintainers choose another result-typing model.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded contract
recommendation.body: Adopt the optional API as proposed, retaining unknown/raw-first behavior when omitted and requiring exact-head proof after conflict resolution.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged history shows ownership of the current Code Mode performance and catalog design, including the two immediately preceding changes this PR extends.
